findings.evidence: Up and down days are told apart only by fill colour: navy #1b365d (上涨) vs grey (下跌), both solid bodies. Their contrast with each other is about 2:1 and in a black-and-white print they are close to the same dark grey. The legend is two colour swatches.
findings.before: Filled navy body = up, filled grey body = down
findings.after: Use the print convention: hollow body (stroke only) for up days, filled for down days, or add a pattern; keep the colour as a second cue.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.1 Use of Color and 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast; T-GRAYSCALE.
findings.title: Text contrast on real pixels
findings.fix: Darken text or lighten ground; never thin weights on tinted ground.

findings.evidence: dom-794.json: the svg has no role, title or aria-label; the figcaption carries the meaning but is not tied to the graphic, so assistive tech reads axis tick labels ('420 400 380… 3/26 4/1…') as loose text in the HTML/PDF tag tree.
findings.after: <svg role="img" aria-labelledby="fig1-cap">…</svg><figcaption id="fig1-cap">…</figcaption>; mark tick labels aria-hidden.
findings.title: Images have text alternatives
findings.fix: Write what the image tells the reader, or alt="" if it tells nothing.

findings.evidence: Failed T-THREE-LINE (falsifiable) for one column: FY2024 and Q1 2026 are given exactly ($97.7B, $477M, $0.13) but FY2025 is all approximations ('~$3.0B', '~$0.86', '~17%', '~4%'), and FY2024/FY2025 free cash flow and capex are '--' although those are reported figures. The '--' and '~' are honest, but the table mixes reported and estimated values without saying which is which.
findings.after: Fill reported FY figures from the 10-K, or footnote the column: 'FY2025 为估算' and '-- = 未披露'. [DATA NEEDED: FY2024/FY2025 FCF and capex]
